name: split-compare
description: Myth vs Math: the MYTH chit lands, gets scratched out with a red pen, then the MATH chit is slapped down below it (record-scratch twist). The chits never overlap: they keep a clear gap of at least `gap` px (default 30) at their closest tilted corners. Main text is set at headline scale, sized by the longer side (textSize "auto": ≤8 chars 128 px, ≤14 → 100, ≤22 → 80, else 66; or a px number). `offsetY` (px, default 0) shifts both chits down (negative up) to fill the middle of the screen. Works best on the note2000 field.
